title: Run Codeforces samples
summary: Compile their Codeforces solution and run it on the problem's sample tests, reporting which pass.
guidance: Pipe each sample copied exactly from the problem page as `=== input`, its lines, `=== output`, its lines (saved samples can be omitted later); say its result in one sentence (pass, fail, crash or compile error, with the line it gives) and never explain or change their code.
